notes.claim: The `Description` textarea's disabled visual treatment (`cursor: 'not-allowed'`, `opacity: 0.55`) is hand-written CSS rather than a `@ds` component, because the textarea is already a documented DS gap (spec's DS-gaps table, `1_DS for dev` has no textarea primitive). The `0.55` opacity and `not-allowed` cursor exactly match every disabled `@ds` control (`Input.jsx`, `Select.jsx`, `Checkbox.jsx`, `Button.jsx` all use `opacity: disabled ? 0.55 : 1`), so this is not an improvised value — it mirrors the design system's own convention for the one native element the spec already excuses. Not a blocker under CR-11.

summary: PATCH-003 implemented in the single file the spec names. Verified against the rule text: To renders first with no value and placeholder 'Choose a recipient'; About/Title/Description/Project/For are disabled while unset and enabled once a kind is chosen; Priority, Needed by, the blocking checkbox, Cancel and Create request stay enabled throughout and the submit control is never disabled for validation (CR-09); submitting with an unset kind short-circuits before validateNewRequest, sets only `request-new-error-assignee-kind` with REQUEST_MESSAGES.assigneeInvalid ('Choose who this request is for', matches packages/validation/src/index.ts:1885), and moves focus to the To control, matching the existing querySelector('button') focus pattern used by every other Select in this file. No topic/contact read is issued while the kind is unset. Project now filters to `clientId !== null` for the client kind; For filters contacts by the selected project's clientId, offers nothing and reads 'Choose a project first' until a project is picked, and clears on project change. Colleague-kind behaviour for Project/For is untouched. Needed by is seeded with `todayInTimeZone` and bounded by `requestNeededByMax` from packages/validation (PATCH-002, already merged). All data-testids in the contracts table are present and wired as specified. The three e2e files add the addressee-kind choice everywhere PATCH-003 requires it and correctly leave TC-01-E2E-02 submitting with the kind unset first (spec's stated exception), before choosing it to continue exercising the rest of the field errors. Ran the diff's own test files (`requests.spec.ts`, `client-participants.spec.ts`, `request-topics.spec.ts`, `regressions.spec.ts`) on ports 3100/4100: 34 passed, 0 failed. No blocking findings.
